name: dnd-dm-b
title_zh: 自带 7000 条规则库的 DND 5e 中文地下城
tagline_zh: 翻规则不用再切网页——GBK 秒查、38 个官方模组、2024 预置角色卡全在本地。跑团时喊一声。
tagline_en: Stop tab-switching mid-session. GBK-fast rules lookup, 38 official modules, 2024 pregens, and ASCII battle.
desc_en: Complete D&D 5th Edition Chinese Dungeon Master Skill (Version B). Integrated with the massive Chinese D&D 5e compendium (5echm, 7,000+ rules & 38 official modules). Features instant GBK-decoded rules lookup, cross-platform dice engine, Chinese 2024 premade characters, official adventure modules, and tactical ASCII battle maps.
why_zh: 别的 DM 工具要你自备规则书，它直接把 5echm 整本塞进上下文。GBK 解码保证中文不乱码。
why_en: Other DM tools assume you own the rulebooks; this one embeds the entire 5echm compendium. GBK decoding keeps Chinese clean, dice.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 D&D 5e（含 2024 版），不认其他 TRPG 规则。需要能联网拉取 5echm 数据源。
limit_en: D&D 5e (incl. 2024) only—no other TRPG systems. Needs network to fetch 5echm data; offline lookup limited to cached entries. Maps are ASCII art, not.
title_en: Chinese D&D 5e DM with 7,000-rule compendium built in
